source_claim: AlphaEvolve evaluates generated programs against existing codebases and expensive systems tasks, so validator execution evidence must separate local subprocess policy metadata from real OS/container sandboxing and resource enforcement.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve emits and validates startup policies.validator_execution, per-attempt evaluation.metadata.validator_boundary records, run-artifact validator-boundary scans, local subprocess execution scope, candidate-root cwd policy, declared problem-file access policy, filesystem_capabilities records, validator_network_policy records, Python socket-denial metadata, minimal environment and redacted output secret boundaries, wall-clock timeout cleanup, and resource_limit_policy metadata. It does not claim OS/container sandbox enforcement, kernel or container network egress control, OS-enforced filesystem capabilities, CPU/memory/GPU/disk/process quotas, native-extension network denial proof, or distributed evaluator-worker resume state.
